title: Carrow Coast Almanac — Fernhaven Seed Library
text: The Fernhaven Seed Library is a community seed-lending collection in the coastal town of Fernhaven. Established in 2014 by Maren Odell, it occupies the former lifeboat station on Quay Street and holds a catalogue of roughly nine hundred vegetable, herb and flower varieties. Membership is free; borrowers are expected to return seed saved from their own crops. The library's Seedling Swap, held each April, has become one of the town's larger spring events.
notes: Encyclopedia-ish register. Says 'established in 2014' — same founding year as gazette-2019's 'founded in 2014', different wording, deliberately consistent. 'Roughly nine hundred varieties' agrees with the annual report's 912.
